item.title: Hungary, Ukraine agree to reset ties, Magyar says
item.description: Budapest and Kyiv agreed to put their relations on a new footing, Hungary's Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on Friday after meeting Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, as the leaders aim to calm tensions over minority rights.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Budapest and Kyiv agreed to put their relations on a new footing, Hungary's Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on Friday after meeting Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, as the leaders aim to calm tensions over minority rights. Magyar has taken a less confrontational stance towards Kyiv than his predecessor Viktor Orban. He had repeatedly said that Hungary would not send arms to Ukraine, however, and demanded progress on the rights of its ethnic Hungarian minority. "I assured the Ukrainian president of my full solidarity over the inhuman Russian aggression against his country," Magyar wrote in a Facebook post after what he called his first official bilateral meeting with Zelenskiy in Brussels. Magyar also said that Hungary was ready to assist Ukraine by all possible diplomatic means to reach a ceasefire and lasting peace. Zelenskiy called the meeting "very good" and said that the two leaders discussed a lot of topics. He also said that he "won't mind" visiting Budapest. Warmer relations between Hungary and Ukraine are pivotal for the European Union's backing for Kyiv in Russia's war in Ukraine. Former Prime Minister Orban had opposed the flow of billions of euros in aid to Ukraine and its EU membership. Orban made scepticism towards support for Ukraine in its war with Russia a central plank of his campaign ahead of an April election that ended his premiership after 16 years. On Tuesday, Ukraine took a step forward in its European Union membership bid, [USN:L8N45Z23B TEXT:"opening talks with the bloc"] on internal market and competitiveness standards, after Hungary dropped its objections. Magyar's government backed the move after Ukraine's parliament [USN:L1N45Y0GI TEXT:"passed legislation"] on Monday expanding the rights of Hungarian speakers and other minorities to receive education in their native language. "I welcomed the political agreement reached between Hungary and Ukraine on strengthening the rights of the Transcarpathian Hungarian minority," Magyar said after his meeting with Zelenskiy. He also said that he considered the passing of the legislation on minority education "as the first step in restoring mutual trust" between the two countries.

item.title: TSX opens higher as energy shares lead gains
item.description: Canada's main stock index opened higher on Friday, led by gains in energy shares, while investors weighed Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem's warning on persistent energy-price pressures on interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Canada's main stock index opened higher on Friday, led by gains in energy shares, while investors weighed Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem's warning on persistent energy-price pressures on interest rates. The S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) was up 0.3% at 36,249.71 points at 09:31 a.m. ET.

Oct 16 : Rafael Jodar apologised on Friday for swearing at a ball kid during his last-16 match at the Shanghai Masters, with the Spaniard saying that he could not control his emotions when frustrations boiled over. After losing a point in Wednesday's win over Dutchman Botic van de Zandschulp, Jodar angrily asked the ball kid to hand him his towel, swearing in Spanish. The chair umpire Jimmy Pinoargote, who also speaks Spanish, gave Jodar a code violation for unsportsmanlike conduct. Pinoargote then warned Jodar not to speak like that to ball kids when the 20-year-old argued with him over the violation. "I shouldn't have done that to the ball kid. It was my mistake. I respect a lot the ball kids and the umpires in all the matches and all the tournaments. I shouldn't have treated the ball kid the way I did," Jodar told reporters after his quarter-final win over Casper Ruud.

"I was very frustrated because how the match was going for me. It was a very close point. I didn't mean to hurt the feelings of the ball kid or anything, I was just frustrated with me. I couldn't control my emotions at that point of the match. "I'll try not to do it again, because that's not the right way to treat the ball kids. I respect a lot their job and it wasn't anything against him or against any ball kids or umpire." Jodar, who beat Ruud 4-6 6-4 6-3 to reach the semi-finals on Friday, said the umpire made the right decision and he should have accepted the warning. The Spaniard also said he would like the opportunity to apologise to the ball kid in person.

item.title: Wall St opens muted as tech jitters linger; Tesla gains
item.description: Wall Street's main indexes opened largely muted on Friday as worries about cracks in the AI trade pressured semiconductor stocks, while gains in Tesla provided some support.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Wall Street's main indexes opened largely muted on Friday as worries about cracks in the AI trade pressured semiconductor stocks, while gains in Tesla provided some support. The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 130.6 points, or 0.25%, at the open to 52,308.28. The S&P 500 (.SPX) rose 1.3 points, or 0.02%, at the open to 7,745.32, while the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) dropped 60 points, or 0.22%, to 26,652.985 at the opening bell.

item.title: France, Germany strike deal on car emissions and UK special status
item.description: France and Germany struck a deal on Friday to soften proposed EU car emissions rules and open the door for Britain to be treated as a trusted partner under the bloc's Made in EU rules.
item.dc:creator: Philip Blenkinsop
item.content:encoded: France and Germany struck a deal on Friday to soften proposed EU car emissions rules and open the door for Britain to be treated as a trusted partner under the bloc's [USN:L6N45E0Q1 TEXT:""Made in EU" rules"]. The European Commission [USN:L6N3XM0EA TEXT:"proposed last year"] that automakers cut CO2 emissions by 90% from 2021 levels in 2035, with the remaining 10% offset through measures such as the use of low-carbon steel and alternative fuels. Under the Franco-German plan, the 2035 target would be set at 90%, but without the need for additional compensatory measures. The approach is broadly in line with the wishes of German automakers. European automotive stocks gained after the deal was announced, lifting the STOXX 600 Automobile and Parts Index (.SXAP) nearly 2%. The joint plan also addresses an EU proposal introducing local-content and low-carbon requirements for products bought through public procurement, public auctions or subsidy schemes. France has pushed for these products to be limited to those manufactured in the European Union. Other EU members, including Germany, argue that countries closely linked to EU automotive supply chains and free-trade-agreement partners should also be included. The Franco-German plan says that for the automotive sector, "Made in EU" should cover the EU's 27 countries and other European partners that were part of the EU internal market on January 1, 2020. That would include Britain, which left the EU single market at the end of 2020. An official at British Prime Minister Andy Burnham's Downing Street office said inclusion in the "Made in EU" scheme would be good news for Britain's automotive sector. However, he said the Franco-German proposal would need wider European backing and that details had yet to be seen. The Franco-German plan also says that inclusion should be subject to an agreement on full reciprocity, along with "dynamic alignment with EU conditions for investment from third countries and with EU trade protection measures". That could mean Britain adopting measures the EU has taken to [USN:L6N45V0LF TEXT:"restrict imports"] of Chinese-built hybrid and battery-electric vehicles. A GOOD DAY FOR JOBS OR A 'HISTORIC MISTAKE'? The Franco-German paper also proposed compliance periods spanning multiple years for CO2 emission targets, no revision before 2030 of the utility factor for hybrid vehicles, which measures the share of driving done electrically, and recognition of cars powered by renewable and low-carbon fuels as zero-emission vehicles. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz called the deal "a good day for motorists and for jobs in Germany, France and Europe". The deal will not please all automakers. Toyota's (7203.T) European division, which sells cars in Europe from plants in the EU, Britain, Turkey and Japan, said on Thursday that including trusted partners such as Britain, Canada, Japan, South Korea and Turkey would give the EU the scale needed to compete with China. [USN:L1N45Z0LF TEXT:"Turkey's trade minister"] said this week on a trip to Brussels that trusted partners such as Turkey should not be excluded. Green and environmental groups criticised the emissions proposals. German Greens lawmaker Swantje Michaelsen said the German government was holding back the automotive industry, with high fuel prices already accelerating demand for EVs. Anna Krajinska of transport and environment campaign group T&E called the deal a "historic mistake" that would reduce the incentive for industry to invest in EVs. "German and French political leaders claim they are acting to save jobs, but this may well be the deal that buries Europe’s auto industry," she said. France and Germany still need to convince other EU members and the European Parliament for their plans to enter into force. They are unlikely to reach a final common text before early next year, after an EU-UK summit planned for November 20.

item.title: Norwegian teen sentenced to 20 years for UK murder plot tied to Iran-linked group
item.description: A Norwegian teenager who planned to commit murder in Britain after being recruited by a Swedish organised crime group linked to the Iranian government was on Friday sentenced to 20 years' detention.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Norwegian teenager who planned to commit murder in Britain after being recruited by a Swedish organised crime group linked to the Iranian government was on Friday sentenced to 20 years' detention. Johannes Natland, now 19, was arrested in a hotel room in Huddersfield, northern England, in March 2025 with two firearms and ammunition in his possession. Natland was recruited by the Foxtrot Network, a Swedish organised crime group used by the Iranian state and sanctioned by both Britain and the United States, prosecutors said. He admitted possessing a semi-automatic pistol, a revolver and ammunition, but denied conspiracy to murder and claimed he did not intend to carry out the plan. But he was [USN:L8N43V1IV TEXT:"convicted in July"] after a retrial and was sentenced at London's Woolwich Crown Court to detention for 20 years. Natland was the latest young adult to stand trial in Britain and elsewhere over serious criminal acts allegedly carried out after being recruited online for money, often as an [USN:L1N42O05G TEXT:"unwitting proxy"] for a foreign state.

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Oct 16 : Shares in computer chip packaging equipment maker BE Semiconductor Industries (Besi) fell 3 per cent on Friday after influential semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis reported that one of the company's main growth products will face competition from bigger rival ASML. The SemiAnalysis report analysed 27 patent filings by ASML, which it said indicated ASML was developing a hybrid bonding product. Besi is a fraction of the size of ASML, the biggest maker of equipment used to make semiconductors, but Besi is a leader in hybrid bonding, an advanced packaging technology being used to create a new generation of more powerful three-dimensional chips.   ASML has not confirmed it is developing such a tool. Besi did not respond to requests for comment.

Besi shares were down 3 per cent at €158.50, while ASML was up 1.1 per cent at €1,480 in midday Amsterdam trading. A spokesperson for ASML declined to comment on the SemiAnalysis report but pointed to the company's launch of its first advanced packaging tool last year. "We continue to look at which directions the 3D integration industry will evolve ... and where ASML's expertise can be of additional value," the company said in a statement at that time. In March, Reuters reported that ASML was planning additional packaging tools, citing Chief Technical Officer Marco Pieters in an interview. "The semiconductor market has already signalled that packaging is one of those next frontiers where performance gains can be unlocked, and ASML seems to be building next-gen tools headed in the same direction," said Nick Rossolillo, co-founder of Chip Stock Investor. "We see the new batch of packaging tools, beyond an EUV pipeline, as critical to pulling off the growth needed to justify (ASML's) elevated valuation."

item.title: Canadian steelmakers offset some U.S. tariff pain with domestic demand
item.description: Canada’s steel industry, among the sectors hit first and hardest by U.S. President Donald Trump’s tariffs, is starting to turn a corner thanks to an uptick in mining, energy and AI data centre ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: TORONTO -- Canada’s steel industry, among the sectors hit first and hardest by U.S. President Donald Trump’s tariffs, is starting to turn a corner thanks to an uptick in mining, energy and AI data centre projects as well as government support, although the impact has not been even across the country. While Canada is a small producer globally and steel contributes less than 1 per cent to national GDP, it is one sector in which Prime Minister Mark Carney’s efforts to make Canada’s economy less reliant on the United States appear to be having some success, albeit with a heavy dose of government intervention. Steel companies have been diversifying away from the U.S. and focusing on domestic demand since Trump increased tariffs on imported steel from 25 per cent to 50 per cent in June 2025, steelmakers, analysts and union representatives said. Canada used to send around 90 per cent of its steel exports to the U.S., but shipments plummeted by 60 per cent in 2025, according to the Canadian Steel Producers Association. Hundreds of steelworkers have been laid off. But the share of steel used in Canada that was produced domestically rose to 51 per cent in 2025, up from 41 per cent in 2024, according to United Steelworkers, the sector’s main labor union. The import share declined from 59 per cent to 49 per cent. USW calculated the data based on World Steel Data and Canada’s imported steel data, said Guio Jacinto, an economic researcher for the union. The green shoots are mostly appearing in western Canada, where some large industrial projects including a 1.2 gigawatt data centre in Saskatchewan are under construction. Carney said a new oil pipeline to the Pacific Coast would also boost demand for steel. Canadian steel demand is estimated to have grown around 2.7 per cent in 2025 and is projected to increase by about 0.9 per cent in 2026, according to an OECD report published in July. “What we are seeing right now is that more Canadian companies are competing for domestic market, which means there is less space for steelmakers from outside,” said David Fritz of Alberta-based Supreme Steel, which manufactures fabricated steel. “I feel optimistic for the outlook of fabricated steel market in Canada, there are enough projects in pipeline to support this industry,” Fritz added. Government intervention At a time of excess global capacity, Canadian steel would struggle to compete with lower-cost producers in China and South Korea without import quotas. Canada produces around 13 million tonnes of primary steel annually. In May, the federal government announced $1 billion (US$700 million) in loans to the steel, aluminum and copper industries as working capital funding to get through the impact of U.S. tariffs. The government extended a cap on foreign steel coming into the country, known as tariff rate quota, to address the issue of foreign steel dumping. Canada’s adaptation to Trump’s tariffs has been closely watched internationally, as Carney is one of the few global leaders to retaliate against U.S. tariffs despite his country’s overwhelming economic dependence on the U.S.. The prime minister also threatened legal action against U.S. steel producer Cleveland-Cliffs over plans to cut hundreds of jobs at its Hamilton, Ont., facility. Cleveland-Cliffs, which acquired Canada’s Stelco in 2024, said in its second-quarter earnings there was steep international competition for the galvanized steel produced at the Hamilton plant, but the market for its specific hot-rolled steel produced elsewhere in Canada contributed to improved guidance for the second half of 2026. Cleveland-Cliffs will report quarterly results on October 19, potentially giving a clearer picture of the future of its Canadian operations. Domestic market pivot Luxembourg-headquartered Tenaris, which manufactures steel pipes for energy companies at its Sault Ste Marie, Ontario, facility, said it recently invested $306 million to expand production of its Canadian-made products for Canadian customers. “This strengthens Tenaris’s commitment to produce in Canada what Canada’s oil and gas industry needs. As a result, the company’s exposure to the United States tariffs is limited,” said Martín Castro, president of Tenaris in Canada, in an email. The largest Canadian steel producer, Algoma, said in December it would lay off 1,000 workers in Ontario – accounting for nearly all of the sector layoffs nationally since tariffs were imposed. But the company’s CEO recently touted the strengthening domestic market, citing growing infrastructure, construction and defense demand for its discrete steel plate. “While the 50 per cent U.S. Section 232 tariffs continue to effectively foreclose our traditional access to the U.S. market, our pivot to a Canada-centric, plate-first strategy is working,” CEO Rajat Marwah said on an earnings call in July. Marty Warren, head of the Canadian branch of the USW, said there has been a turnaround in the industry but a bigger revival would require replacing even more imported steel with domestic production. The union also wants Canada to tighten the quota on imported steel and put tariffs on steel used in the U.S. auto and aviation industries, which are currently exempt from broader retaliatory tariffs by Canada. Canada’s finance ministry said the steel sector remained exposed to tariffs and the government was encouraging investment through a number of policies, such as buying Canadian steel for infrastructure projects. “This is evidenced by the domestic demand cycle we are enabling through the Buy Canadian policy and more generally the government’s growth agenda which will require Canadian steel and workers,” the ministry said in an emailed statement. Divya Rajagopal in Toronto, additional reporting by Promit Mukherjee; Editing by Caroline Stauffer and Nia Williams, Reuters

item.title: イスラエル人入植者、ヨルダン川西岸でオリーブ収穫中の村人襲撃
item.description:
Pesha Magid
[アブファラ（ヨルダン川西岸） １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Pesha Magid

[アブファラ（ヨルダン川西岸） １６日 ロイター] - 覆面をしたイスラエル人入植者数十人が１６日、パレスチナ自治区ヨルダン川西岸の村でオリーブを収穫していた村人を組織的に襲撃し、木を焼いたり、石を投げたりした。記者を含む少なくとも２人が負傷した。

現場を目撃したロイター記者によると、オリーブの実を摘むためにアブファラの村人が畑に集まっていたところ、入植者約８０人が畑を見下ろす丘から下りてきた。一部は投石器を使い、村人たちに向けて石を放ったという。

襲撃のさなか、イスラエル軍のジープ少なくとも２台が土ぼこりを上げながら現場一帯を走行した。軍の到着後も襲撃は続き、イスラエル兵はジープを避けて逃げたパレスチナ人に向けて催涙ガスを発射した。

現場では実弾の発砲音が聞こえた。ロイターの写真記者は武装した入植者少なくとも１人が銃を撃つのを目撃した。

イスラエル軍はコメント要請に応じていない。

パレスチナの医療関係者によると、２人が負傷し、ラマラ周辺の病院に搬送された。うち１人は米紙ワシントン・ポストの写真記者だった。

アブファラでの襲撃に先立ち、１６日朝にはトゥルムスアヤ村周辺でも同様の襲撃があった。入植者らはオリーブを収穫していた農家の集団を襲い、車３台に火を付けた。

イスラエルの入植活動を監視する人権団体「イェシュ・ディン」によると、占領下のヨルダン川西岸では、イスラエル人入植者によるパレスチナ人への暴力が急増している。オリーブ収穫が始まった頃にあたる９月２７日以降、少なくとも１７０件の襲撃が起きた。

ネタニヤフ首相は暴力を批判しているが、取り締まりに向けた措置はほとんど講じていない。

item.title: ペトロチャイナ、取引部門の26年利益が過去最高に 中東情勢の影響回避
item.description:
Chen Aizhu
[シンガポール １６日 ロイター] - 中国石油天然気（ペトロチャイナ）で、原油などの取引を手...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ペトロチャイナ、取引部門の26年利益が過去最高に　中東情勢の影響回避 19:33 配信

ペトロチャイナのロゴ、メディア向け視察ツアーで6月撮影 REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov

Chen Aizhu

[シンガポール １６日 ロイター] - 中国石油天然気（ペトロチャイナ）で、原油などの取引を手掛けるトレーディング部門の２０２６年の利益が過去最高を更新する見通しであることが、複数の関係者の話で分かった。イラン紛争によって中東産原油の売買形態が一変し、需給が逼迫する中、中国国外の製油所の利幅が大幅に拡大している。

アジア最大の石油・天然ガス生産会社で中国第２位の石油精製会社であるペトロチャイナは、大規模な生産・供給ポートフォリオと広範な精製・小売りネットワークを生かして利益を上げ、戦争に伴う供給混乱の影響を回避できている。

事情に詳しい関係者２人によると、ペトロチャイナのトレーディング部門、中国石油国際事業（ＰＣＩ）の２６年粗利益は２００億元（３０億ドル）を超え過去最高になる見込み。

同部門の幹部によると、通常、ＰＣＩ部門利益の半分以上を稼ぎ出す原油部門の利益が１０月初旬までに、２５年通年の２倍以上に達したほか、石油製品部門や天然ガス部門も好調に推移している。

同社は決算でトレーディング部門利益の内訳を開示していない。８月に発表した上半期グループ純利益は約１４６億５０００万ドルだった。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：サウジを揺さぶるフーシ派、攻撃力向上の背景は アングル：米国の「軽油ショック」、消費者の身の回りで着実に進行 アングル：ＡＩ株売りに勢い、資金調達に懸念　クライマックスには距離 アングル：ＥＵの自動車現地調達ルール案、中国勢は先回りで足場固め アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え 最終更新: 10/16(金) 19:33 ロイター

item.title: CoreWeave stock, bond set for weekly plunge as rate-hike fears hit AI bet
item.description: CoreWeave's shares and bonds were set for steep weekly losses on Friday, underscoring investor worries over the cloud-computing company's $50 billion debt load that has rippled across the AI industry.
item.dc:creator: Niket Nishant, Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: CoreWeave's (CRWV.O) shares and bonds were set for steep weekly losses on Friday, underscoring investor worries over the cloud-computing company's $50 billion debt load that has rippled across the AI industry. The Nvidia-backed company came into focus this week after the latest inflation data boosted [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"bets on interest-rate hikes"], raising the chances of higher payout on borrowings by data center and AI infrastructure firms with huge debt. CoreWeave shares fell more than 6% in early trading after tumbling over 15% this week, their worst week in nearly two months. "A hot inflation print triggered a sharp selloff in CoreWeave because its business model is a highly indebted play on future data center demand," BCA Research analysts said. "Although the rest of the tech complex is also sensitive to the pace and magnitude of AI adoption and use, it is, on average, considerably less sensitive to interest rates," they said. The selloff is a stark reminder that AI companies' reliance on debt is becoming a risk for investors and punctures the notion that companies at the heart of the AI boom are immune to macroeconomic headwinds. CoreWeave's stock has already lost about a fifth of its value, or nearly 9.6 billion, so far this month. DEBT MARKET JITTERS The yield on CoreWeave's October 2031 maturity dollar bond briefly surged past 16% on Thursday. It is set to decline for a fifth straight week, down about 3 cents on the dollar this week. The cost of insuring against CoreWeave's debt has surged past 1,000 basis points to record highs this week, according to data from S&P Global Market Intelligence. Investor worries over CoreWeave's massive debt load and distressed bond yields had a contagion affect that impacted rival Nebius Group (NBIS.O) , whose shares were set for their steepest weekly fall in two months. Still, several analysts were not ready to throw in the towel. Evercore analysts maintained their outperform rating on CoreWeave stock. "The markets appear to be extrapolating a higher secondary-market bond yield as evidence the business model has stopped working, which we don't think is the case," they wrote in a note. Others argued the rout in CoreWeave should not be seen as a sign that the AI rally is coming to an end. "You cannot take CoreWeave as the poster child for AI," said Tommaso Leodari, chief investment officer at Dubai-based hedge fund Index & Cie.

item.title: Eli Lilly's weight-loss pill wins EU drug regulator's backing
item.description: The European Medicines Agency's committee on Friday recommended approval of Eli Lilly's weight-loss pill Foundayo, the second oral obesity drug to win the agency's backing after Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Medicines Agency's committee on Friday recommended approval of Eli Lilly's (LLY.N) weight-loss pill Foundayo, the second oral obesity drug to win the agency's backing after Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) Wegovy pill. The recommendation will now be reviewed by the European Commission before it gives the final nod to launch the drug in the region. Both Novo and Lilly are racing to broaden access to their oral drugs, as they aim to secure a larger share of a market expected to surpass $100 billion by 2030. Foundayo was launched in the US in April and in [USN:L6N44I0QH TEXT:"the UK"] in August, and generated $98 million in sales in the second quarter. Novo's Wegovy pill generated 3.22 billion Danish crowns ($484.50 million) in the same quarter. The pill won EU [USN:L4N43H1NG TEXT:"approval"] in July. It is also available in the US, the UK and the UAE. The EMA on Friday recommended a marketing authorisation for Foundayo for weight management and treatment of type 2 diabetes in adults. The recommendation for Foundayo in weight management is based on two studies involving more than 4,740 adults who were obese or overweight, the agency said. Patients treated with Foundayo lost up to 11% of their body weight. The pill, which Lilly has sought approval for in more than 40 countries, contains orforglipron, a small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist that can help reduce appetite and food intake. Early [USN:L4N41J1X6 TEXT:"US prescription data"] for oral weight-loss drugs has supported expectations that pills could expand the obesity market by attracting patients who have been reluctant to use injections. Foundayo has, however, seen a slower uptake in the US compared to Novo's Wegovy, which was first to the market. Unlike Novo's Wegovy pill, Foundayo can be taken at any time of the day without food or water restrictions, a feature that Lilly has touted as a key advantage of the drug. It remains unclear whether patients perceive Foundayo's convenience as compelling enough to drive broader adoption. ($1 = 6.6460 Danish crowns)

item.description: WASHINGTON, Oct 16 : Blue Origin is targeting multiple flights per week of its New Glenn rocket by the end of the decade, a company executive said on Friday, as it spends billions of dollars on infrastructure needed to match rival SpaceX's launch dominance.Jeff Bezos' space firm also plans to add more launch

Blue Origin targets multiple New Glenn launches weekly by end of decade

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 16 : Blue Origin is targeting multiple flights per week of its New Glenn rocket by the end of the decade, a company executive said on Friday, as it spends billions of dollars on infrastructure needed to match rival SpaceX's launch dominance. Jeff Bezos' space firm also plans to add more launch and landing pads in Florida for New Glenn, its flagship heavy-lift orbital rocket that has been grounded for the year since exploding on the company's only launchpad in May. Blue Origin has invested over $3 billion to date in its sprawling Florida production and rocket integration facilities that span roughly 31 acres with some 5,000 employees, Ian Richardson, senior vice president of operations, said in a company blog post. A $330 million expansion to those facilities will support production of a heavier-lift version of the rocket, New Glenn 9x4, and is targeted for completion in the summer of 2027, Richardson said, adding it will allow annual production of up to 150 upper stages of the rocket.

"These investments are centered on one goal: building the capacity to support more missions, more reliably, and more efficiently," Richardson said. "As we look ahead, this infrastructure is designed to support multiple flights per week by the end of the decade." The New Glenn explosion in May, which happened days before a planned launch of Amazon satellites, badly damaged the company's Florida launchpad, where the 30-storey-tall (322 feet) rocket had lifted off three times since its 2025 debut. New Glenn is expected to return to flight early next year. Its last flight, in April, was its first mission failure when an issue with the rocket's second stage put a satellite from its customer AST SpaceMobile into the wrong orbit, causing it to fall back into Earth's atmosphere. Blue Origin is one of the main launch providers for Amazon's budding satellite internet constellation, Leo, which will rival SpaceX's Starlink. New Glenn's explosion upended Amazon's launch schedule with the rocket, tightening a global launch squeeze that has left dozens of satellite companies desperate for rides to space. Blue Origin has been pressed to return the rocket to its pad, with CEO Dave Limp seeing it as the company's top priority among an array of other programs, including a multibillion-dollar NASA assignment to build a lunar lander that will return astronauts to the moon. Elon Musk's SpaceX, the world's most active launch provider, had 165 Falcon missions last year, mostly carrying its in-house Starlink satellites. Musk envisions launching hundreds of missions per year with Starship, the company's next-generation rocket.

Source: Reuters

item.description: [バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１６日公表した欧州経済の定期見通し報告書で、欧州中央銀行...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ、年内に少なくともあと1回0.25％利上げ　ＩＭＦ予想 19:03 配信

IMFのロゴ。2024年11月にワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１６日公表した欧州経済の定期見通し報告書で、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が高インフレを抑えるため、年内に少なくともあと１回、２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施する可能性が高いとの見方を示した。

米国とイスラエルの対イラン攻撃を背景にエネルギー価格が急騰しインフレが加速したことを受けて、ＥＣＢは６月と９月にそれぞれ２５ｂｐの利上げを実施した。

ＩＭＦは「われわれの分析では、コアインフレを十分に抑制し続けるには、２０２６年中に少なくともあと１回、２５ｂｐの政策金利引き上げが必要になる」と指摘。「２６年より先の政策は今後のデータに応じて調整すべきだが、２８年にインフレ率を確実に目標へ回帰させるには、さらなる引き締めが必要になる可能性が高い」とした。

また「エネルギー価格上昇の影響を和らげるための財政支援は、慎重に設計しなければ、インフレ抑制の取り組みを損なう恐れがある」とも指摘した。

item.description: NEW YORK, Oct 16 : Stumbles in the market-leading AI trade are set to test investor confidence in the rally in the coming week as Wall Street focuses on quarterly results due from key players including Meta Platforms.AI-linked stocks, central to the bull market that just marked its four-year anniversary, str

As AI rally wobbles, stock market's spotlight turns to earnings

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 16 : Stumbles in the market-leading AI trade are set to test investor confidence in the rally in the coming week as Wall Street focuses on quarterly results due from key players including Meta Platforms. AI-linked stocks, central to the bull market that just marked its four-year anniversary, struggled in recent days, with sharp declines in shares of semiconductor companies and tech hardware firms such as Dell Technologies. Meta, among the hyperscalers spending massively to build AI data centers, highlights the upcoming week of quarterly reports, along with semiconductor firms Lam Research and Texas Instruments. "It certainly feels like the narrative in the market is a little bit jittery," said Garrett Melson, portfolio strategist with Natixis Investment Managers Solutions. "Clearly there's a lot of uncertainty around where AI stands right now."

Worries rippled through markets over risks tied to the financing of the AI build-out boom, which has lifted profits for a wide swath of companies and boosted economic growth. Investors were watching developments with CoreWeave, an AI cloud company with about $50 billion in debt. This week, its shares tumbled. In other recent signs of caution, strategists at Deutsche Bank and RBC Capital Markets separately pulled back on their recommendations of the tech sector. On October 9, Deutsche Bank strategists said the rotation into tech had "run far and the risk-reward no longer looks favorable in the near term." Despite the swoon in heavyweight tech and AI stocks, the S&P 500 remained down only about 1 per cent from its record high set this month. Other sectors, which lagged as tech soared in recent weeks, were now picking up the slack.   "This is very much an on-off switch type of market," Melson said. "When AI is working, it sucks all the oxygen out of the room for the rest of the sectors." META KICKS OFF HYPERSCALER RESULTS US reporting season heats up next week, with investors counting on robust performance. S&P 500 companies are expected to have increased earnings by more than 30 per cent in the third quarter, according to LSEG IBES. Massive outlays on AI data centers and infrastructure underpin the profit jump. Meta is one of five AI hyperscalers that combined are expected to increase their capital spending to about $1.2 trillion next year, according to Goldman Sachs. Investors are eager for signs the companies can show returns on the investments, which would build confidence that the spending is sustainable. "One of the most important takeaways of earnings season is whether or not the profitability of the hyperscalers can grow faster than the pace of their capex," said Kevin Shea, senior equity analyst at BNY Wealth. Meta, whose market capitalization was about $1.9 trillion, has seen its shares climb in recent weeks as it launched its Muse AI assistant. "With the cost of capital going up, this capex blowout is going to become more expensive, which raises the bar for returns," said Chuck Carlson, chief executive officer at Horizon Investment Services. "Meta is going to be the first up to try to provide some color around that question." SEMIS, TESLA, NETFLIX ALSO ON TAP Chip companies have been among the biggest beneficiaries of the capital spending boom, but the stocks have cooled off. The Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index has slumped 8 per cent this month, although it remained up more than 60 per cent on the year, compared to a 13 per cent year-to-date gain for the S&P 500.  Investors will look to Wednesday's reports from Lam Research and Texas Instruments for broader indications of demand in the semiconductor industry. Both companies' share prices are up some 60 per cent in 2026. Elsewhere, investors will focus on results from Elon Musk's Tesla, another signature stock of the tech bull market. Streaming giant Netflix, consumer products company Procter & Gamble and engine maker GE Aerospace are among other high-profile reports in the coming week. The rise in Treasury yields and prospects for further rate hikes from the Federal Reserve also remain front-burner issues for stock investors. Hot inflation data this week boosted bets on another rate increase at the Fed's meeting at the end of October. Futures pricing suggested most investors still expect the US central bank to wait until its meeting in December to raise rates for a second time this year. "Another strong earnings season should help equities withstand moderately higher rates," analysts at UBS Global Wealth Management said in a note on Thursday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: CoreWeave bond rout tests market's math on AI buildout
item.description: A sharp decline in CoreWeave's bonds this week is emerging as a test of investors' willingness to keep financing the massive buildout of AI infrastructure, as rising borrowing costs and scrutiny of debt-funded expansion hit the sector.
item.dc:creator: Suzanne McGee, Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
item.content:encoded: A sharp decline in CoreWeave's (CRWV.O) bonds this week is emerging as a test of investors' willingness to keep financing the massive buildout of AI infrastructure, as rising borrowing costs and scrutiny of debt-funded expansion hit the sector. Analysts and portfolio managers said the selloff in the data center operator's debt carries more significance than a concurrent rout in its shares because it may signal a broader reassessment of the risks tied to financing AI projects that may take years to generate revenue. CoreWeave bonds issued in June at a yield of 9.675% have plunged in value, sending their yield to 15% this week. "CoreWeave is absolutely the canary in the coal mine" for a market segment that is coming under more stress, said Max Frumes, global head of distressed and leveraged finance at 9fin, a fintech corporate credit data and analytics company. "This is going to be a turning point in the pricing and availability and structure of credit that's supporting the AI boom," said Frumes, who believes that other AI-linked debt will follow CoreWeave into distressed territory. "It's going to get more expensive. There will be a lot more scrutiny and probably some pushback from investors." CoreWeave shares fell 15.1% from Monday's open through Thursday's close, despite a 6% gain on Thursday after a [USN:L4N46112V TEXT:"vote of confidence from partner Nvidia NVDA.O"]. The decline was broadly in line with weakness in other so-called neocloud companies such as Nebius (NBIS.O) and Iren (IREN.O) . Credit investors said they already are [USN:L6N45611M TEXT:"becoming more selective"]. "We're definitely taking another look at our exposures across the AI infrastructure space, particularly where the risks are concentrated and whether we're being adequately compensated for taking them," said John Han, a portfolio manager at fixed-income asset management firm F/m Investments. F/m's portfolio contains unsecured CoreWeave bonds in one of its exchange-traded funds, but only because they make up part of the index tracked by the ETF. At their current yields those bonds "certainly deserve another look," Han said. He generally prefers to invest in high-yield securities via special purpose vehicles that may offer lower yields but also more collateral and less risk. "The market is being very selective and really singling out anything that has more leverage, and (that may be) in a bit more challenging operating environment," said Larry Holzenthaler, senior portfolio manager of fixed income at Catalyst funds. To Holzenthaler and other investors, what the markets are witnessing now is an overreaction as sentiment shifts from being overly upbeat to downright bearish. In June, the risks driving the selloff -- the sheer size of the funding needs, the leverage, the reliance on outside financing, the risk that the GPUs (graphics processing units) being purchased for data centers would be obsolete before the new facilities could open -- were merely overlooked or downplayed. "A few months ago, I would have said people were just too optimistic around AI," Holzenthaler said. Deutsche Bank global head of macro and thematic research Jim Reid sees the market entering a new phase in which debt financing is becoming increasingly important. "As we move to a capex cycle funded out of debt rather than simply free cash flow, we have to increasingly respect the credit price action," Reid wrote in a recent report. "AI financing costs aren't dramatic overall, but there are worrying themes at the edges." Vanguard bond portfolio manager Brad Collins said assessing AI-related debt has become more challenging as issuers bring increasingly large and varied offerings to market, often forcing investors to make decisions in days or even hours. Rising inflation has pushed financing costs higher overall and fueled concern about what lies ahead for mammoth AI capital spending plans. Then there is the [USN:L6N43G12P TEXT:"growing political controversy"] surrounding the construction of data centers. Even one of the tech sector's stalwarts allows that the road ahead may be bumpy at times. Dan Ives, partner and technology analyst at Yorkville Ives, an investment firm, estimates that 5% to 10% of planned projects ultimately will not be built. "The growing noise around data center permitting and midterm rhetoric on power prices has given investors another reason to step back," Ives said.

item.title: Hegseth's TV instincts backfire as Trump rejects execution livestream
item.description: Trump pulled the plug on Hegseth's plans to livestream the execution of the Fort Hood shooter.
item.dc:creator: Phil Stewart
item.content:encoded: As he took to the stage this week at an Army event, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth remarked how much it looked like a TV set. The former Fox News host said that put him at ease, even as the first in a series of anti-war protesters shouted at him. But Hegseth's TV instincts, while perhaps one of the tools he relies on most in his Pentagon role, appear to have failed him on Thursday when President Donald Trump [USN:FWN4611G3 TEXT:"pulled the plug"] on his plans, announced last week, to livestream the Army's firing-squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan. Trump had been unaware of Hegseth's unprecedented plan to broadcast the execution, said a White House official who spoke on condition of anonymity. Many fellow Republicans, along with religious leaders and international observers, raised objections to the plan, and defense officials who spoke to Reuters on Thursday expressed relief that the livestreaming would not go forward. Defense secretaries often cycle out after a couple of years in the job and speculation in Washington has mounted whether Trump might see value in bringing new management to the Pentagon after November's [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"]. But Republican strategists said it was too soon to say whether Trump's decision to overrule Hegseth would affect their relationship, which has remained strong despite mounting public opposition to the war in Iran. "They've been kind of very closely knit and I don't know whether it means anything at all," Republican strategist Douglas Heye said. Charlie Black, a veteran Republican strategist, said it would likely blow over. "It's a wild thing but nobody will remember it next week," Black said, adding Trump "did the right thing." The Pentagon sought to downplay the first major public split between Trump and Hegseth, saying the two spoke before the US president posted his decision on Truth Social. "The Secretary supports the President's decision, and they are completely aligned," said Sean Parnell, the Pentagon's chief spokesperson. CONGRESSIONAL WORRIES Trump regularly extols Hegseth publicly, and has given the former Army National Guard soldier significant leeway as he seeks to reshape the Pentagon, including by [USN:FWN40L10O TEXT:"firing"] its most senior officers. But after narrowly winning Senate confirmation, Hegseth has failed to win over many Republicans who voiced concerns over his qualifications for the job. Some Republican lawmakers and congressional aides have expressed worries over his expected plans to draw down forces in Europe. One Republican lawmaker filed [USN:L1N4570RB TEXT:"articles of impeachment"] against Hegseth last month, accusing him of abusing his office by executing an order for hostilities against Iran without approval by Congress. While Representative Thomas Massie's measure is not expected to succeed, Democrats could look to move forward with impeachment proceedings if they win control of the House in the upcoming elections in November. At times, the conflict between Hegseth and members of Congress has become personal. Last year, Hegseth sought to [USN:S0N3W400D TEXT:"prosecute"] Democratic Senator Mark Kelly after he and five other Democrats in Congress with backgrounds in the military and intelligence community urged US troops to refuse illegal orders. Kelly on Thursday introduced a bill that would prohibit livestreamed executions. "Livestreaming an execution is un-American and dangerous. It is the kind of thing we see with regimes like Iran and the Taliban in Afghanistan," Kelly said in a statement. The event would have been extraordinary, even for a country that has long employed capital punishment. A government execution has never been broadcast or livestreamed, according to death penalty experts, and the US military has not executed anyone by firing squad since 1945. Hasan was convicted of premeditated murder for shooting dead 13 people and wounding 32 others in a medical facility at the vast Fort Hood base in 2009. Now 56, he requires a wheelchair, having been shot by police during his arrest. Hegseth had argued that making the event public would help show "there's serious consequences for these types of things." Trump appeared to accept Hegseth's argument, saying on Thursday livestreaming it "might have been a strong deterrent for the World to witness how America deals with Terrorists and SCUM like Hasan." But Trump, who is himself a former reality television star, ultimately decided a public show went too far. "Many very good and well meaning people would rather not watch him die, through streaming, or through any other visual device. He will die, as scheduled, by firing squad, but this event will not be streamed," Trump wrote.

item.title: Porsche apuesta por un superdeportivo más caro que el 911 para recuperar sus márgenes de beneficio
item.description: El prototipo Mission S anticipa la apuesta de Porsche por competir con Ferrari y vender menos coches a precios más altos. La marca busca recuperar un margen operativo de entre el 10% y el 15% a medio ...
item.dc:creator: William Wilkes
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Porsche AG ha presentado un prototipo que anticipa un nuevo superdeportivo que se situará por encima del 911 en su gama, como parte de la apuesta del fabricante alemán por que los modelos más caros puedan contribuir a reactivar sus maltrechos márgenes de beneficio. El Mission S, de perfil bajo, con una toma de aire integrada en el techo y faros de inspiración deportiva, es la manifestación más concreta hasta la fecha del plan de reestructuración del CEO Michael Leiters para la histórica marca. Porsche lo está desarrollando no como otro hiperdeportivo de serie limitada, sino como una incursión sostenida en el territorio de Ferrari NV. Ver más: Porsche apuesta por vender menos y más caro con un nuevo modelo por encima del 911 La plataforma de motor central de este superdeportivo será flexible, capaz de albergar sistemas de propulsión híbridos de gasolina y electricidad o de combustión interna pura, según afirmó Leiters en una entrevista en Bloomberg TV. La configuración exacta del motor “sigue siendo un secreto”, pero “será algo que se ajustará plenamente al ADN de Porsche”. Aunque se negó a especificar un precio, Leiters afirmó que el vehículo costará “mucho más” que un 911. La filial de Volkswagen AG lucha por reconstruir un negocio golpeado por el desplome de las ventas en China, los aranceles comerciales de EE.UU. y costosos errores en materia de electrificación. Porsche está recortando puestos de trabajo, reduciendo el número de directivos y recortando el gasto en desarrollo a medida que se adapta a una época más difícil, y planea recuperar beneficios orientándose aún más hacia el segmento de lujo. Esta estrategia acerca a Porsche al modelo de Ferrari, que da prioridad a la exclusividad y al poder de fijación de precios frente al volumen de ventas. Leiters apuesta por que vender menos coches a precios medios significativamente más altos pueda restablecer los márgenes de los que Porsche disfrutaba en su día, con el Mission S al frente de esta iniciativa. Porsche presentó el nuevo modelo en un muelle de Queens, Nueva York, donde, a principios de la década de 1950, se fotografió el 550 Spyder, el pequeño y ligero deportivo conducido por el actor de Hollywood James Dean que contribuyó a consolidar la marca en EE.UU.. Según Porsche, la ‘S’ de Mission S hace referencia tanto a “coche deportivo” como a “Sportwagenschmiede” (que en alemán significa “forja de coches deportivos”). El diseño se ciñe estrechamente a una fórmula tradicional: bajo y ancho, con pasos de rueda musculosos, faros redondos y una silueta que se inspira en gran medida en el pasado de Porsche en el mundo de las carreras. Este enfoque contrasta con el Luce eléctrico de Ferrari, cuyo diseño radical provocó una fuerte reacción negativa. Ver más: Este reloj de titanio solo se consigue cuando compras un Porsche 911 GT3 Leiters está optando por una vía más tradicional, en lugar de utilizar el Mission S para promocionar un futuro totalmente eléctrico. El prototipo anticipa el lenguaje de diseño que Porsche tiene previsto extender a toda su futura gama, según ha declarado Leiters. En el interior, Porsche se opone a la tendencia de abundantes pantallas que arrasa en el sector. Utiliza cinco instrumentos redondos y un cuentarrevoluciones analógico, al tiempo que prescinde de una pantalla central fija o para el acompañante. En su lugar, el conductor puede insertar un smartphone para la navegación y otra información. Ofrecer opciones de motorización de combustión supondría una señal notable por parte de una empresa que actualmente está reajustando su apuesta por la electrificación. La presión financiera es aguda. El margen operativo de Porsche se desplomó hasta el 1,1% el año pasado, desde niveles cercanos al 18% en torno a su salida a bolsa en 2022, afectado por los gastos de reestructuración, los aranceles y una menor demanda. La empresa se ha fijado como objetivo recuperar un margen de entre el 10% y el 15% a medio plazo, al tiempo que reduce su volumen de equilibrio a unas 200.000 unidades, partiendo de una base de costos calculada para unas 350.000. Hay indicios de que la apuesta por los modelos más caros está dando sus frutos. El beneficio operativo se disparó un 34%, hasta los 1.350 millones de euros (US$1.500 millones), en los primeros seis meses del año, y las entregas del 911 aumentaron en torno a una quinta parte. Ver más: Porsche eleva previsión de margen de flujo de caja tras venta de Bugatti por €1.000 millones Los problemas de Porsche también se han convertido en un quebradero de cabeza para Volkswagen. El mes pasado, la empresa matriz realizó una amortización de 6.000 millones de euros sobre el valor de su participación en Porsche, ya que el desplome de la demanda china la obligó a recortar sus propias previsiones de beneficios. Recuperar la rentabilidad de Porsche y de la marca de lujo Audi es fundamental, ya que el mayor fabricante de automóviles de Europa está recortando puestos de trabajo y reduciendo la capacidad de sus fábricas, al tiempo que intenta financiar nuevos coches eléctricos, software y otras tecnologías. Aunque el Mission S es oficialmente un prototipo, Porsche tiene un historial de presentar vehículos que anticipan con gran precisión lo que finalmente llega a los clientes. El Mission E de 2015 se convirtió en el Taycan, totalmente eléctrico, conservando gran parte de su diseño, mientras que el Carrera GT apareció por primera vez como un prototipo casi de serie en el Salón del Automóvil de París de 2000, antes de entrar en producción en serie tres años más tarde. Un modelo de serie del Mission S supondría el primer regreso de Porsche al segmento de los supercoches desde que el 918 Spyder, con un precio de 768.026 euros, salió a la venta en 2013, del que solo se fabricaron 918 unidades antes de que cesara su producción. -Con la colaboración de Matthew Miller. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Chelsea captain James out for 'several weeks' after knee surgery
item.description: Chelsea captain Reece James will be sidelined for several weeks, manager Xabi Alonso said on Friday, following successful minor knee surgery after an injury in training.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chelsea captain Reece James will be sidelined for several weeks, manager Xabi Alonso said on Friday, following successful minor knee surgery after an injury in training. “He wanted to have a good start after the international break, but in the last training (session) he picked up an injury," Alonso told a press conference before his side visit Everton in the Premier League on Saturday. "We wanted to be cautious and wait to know the result of the tests, but now the surgery has gone well and has been successful ... We don’t set timelines, but he will be out for several weeks." The 26-year-old wing back was injured ahead of Chelsea's 5-1 victory over Bournemouth at Stamford Bridge last Saturday. British media said James is likely to be out for three months. The England international has suffered numerous injuries over the past few seasons and was left out of the squad for the most recent international fixtures because of injury.

item.title: 株・債券に資金流入、現金からシフト＝ＢｏｆＡ
item.description: ［ロンドン １６日 ロイター］ - ＢｏｆＡグローバル・リサーチによると、投資家は１４日までの１週間に現金を減らし、債...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
株・債券に資金流入、現金からシフト＝ＢｏｆＡ 18:45 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所で8月撮影。 REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

［ロンドン　１６日　ロイター］ - ＢｏｆＡグローバル・リサーチによると、投資家は１４日までの１週間に現金を減らし、債券と株式に資金を投じた。

ＢｏｆＡがＥＰＦＲのデータを基にまとめた世界市場の週間資金フローは以下の通り。

・株式ファンドには６４５億ドル流入。

・ハイテク株に１０７億ドル流入した。年初来の流入額は過去最高の１９６０億ドル。米国株には３９１億ドル流入し、年初来では過去最高の６３６０億ドル。

・ハイテク株はここ数営業日、荒い値動きが続いており、ナスダック総合指数は１５日に１．８％下落した。同日、国債価格は急伸し、米１０年債利回りは１０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下した。ただ、国債はここ数カ月、売られ続けていた。

・債券には１１８億ドル流入。米国債には３６億ドルが流入し、１６週連続の流入。連続流入期間は２０２４年８月以来の長さ。米債券運用大手ＰＩＭＣＯのシニアアドバイザーは先週、売り込まれた米国債は「極めて割安」だと述べていた。

・「キャッシュ」と呼ばれるＭＭＦからは５３１億ドルが流出。

・新興国市場には１７７億ドルが流入。このうち中国が８６億ドルだった。

・ブラジルにはこの２週間で過去最高の４７億ドルが流入。１０月上旬に行われたブラジル大統領選の第１回投票では、右派のボルソナロ上院議員が予想を上回る得票。同氏は左派のルラ大統領と決選投票で争う。

item.title: 経産省、台湾ＴＳＭＣの3ナノ半導体生産計画を認定 熊本第2工場
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 経済産業省は１６日、半導体受託生産の世界最大手、台湾積...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
経産省、台湾ＴＳＭＣの3ナノ半導体生産計画を認定　熊本第2工場 18:42 配信

ＴＳＭＣのロゴ。台北で7月撮影。 REUTERS/Ann Wang

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 経済産業省は１６日、半導体受託生産の世界最大手、台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）が熊本県に建設中の第２工場で回路線幅３ナノメートル（ナノは１０億分の１）の先端半導体を生産するための計画変更を認定した。従来は６ナノや１２ナノ、４０ナノを計画していたが、変更後は３ナノに専念する。

現時点での生産枚数は月６０００枚を計画しているが、今後、日本政府の支援を前提に具体的数量を検討する。経産省は来年度予算で支援資金を要求中で、既に生産開始している第１工場を含む最大助成額は１兆円を超える見通し。

経産省の南部友成・情報産業課長は記者団に「これからのＡＩ（人工知能）トランスフォーメーションを考えれば、ＡＩ自体を支える３ナノの最先端ロジック半導体は必要不可欠だ」と指摘。国内に３ナノの生産拠点を確保することは「日本のサプライチェーン強靭化や経済安全保障の強化にとって非常に有意義だ」と述べた。

ＴＳＭＣの魏哲家最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２月、高市早苗首相と会談した際、第２工場で３ナノ半導体を生産する計画を伝えていた。同社は、今回の計画変更で熊本県の第１、第２工場への設備投資額が計２３０億ドル（約３兆６３００億円）を超える見込みとし「日本と世界中の顧客に先端技術を提供し、ＡＩ時代における強力な需要に対応していく」とコメントした。

item.title: 中国人民銀総裁、金融市場開放加速と人民元国際化推進表明
item.description: ［北京／上海 １６日 ロイター］ - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁は、巨大な国内金融市場の一段の対外開放を進...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国人民銀総裁、金融市場開放加速と人民元国際化推進表明 18:40 配信

中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁。2024年9月、北京で撮影。 REUTERS/Tingshu Wang

［北京／上海　１６日　ロイター］ - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁は、巨大な国内金融市場の一段の対外開放を進める方針を示し、人民元建て資産は世界の投資家の間で高まる分散投資ニーズに応えることができると表明した。国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行総裁が開かれているタイのバンコクで１５日に行った講演内容を、人民銀行が発表した。

潘氏は講演で、地政学リスクの高まりや世界経済の構造的な変化、人工知能（ＡＩ）の急速な進展に言及した。

「中国の着実な経済成長とハイテク産業の急速な発展は、人民元資産の確固たる支えとなる」と述べ、人民銀が投融資を促進するため、引き続きリスク管理ツールの拡充を進める方針を示した。

トランプ米大統領の関税措置や予測困難な外交政策によってドル資産の信認が損なわれる中、中国は資本市場の対外開放と人民元の国際化を推進する取り組みを強化している。

潘氏は、人民元建て債券が適格担保として世界的に受容され活用が拡大することを推進し、国境を越えた金融インフラの接続性を強化し、オフショア人民元市場の発展を支援すると表明した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：前途開けた中国人民銀行、「バズーカ砲」不要か コラム：人民元／円相場の記録的高騰に見る円の構造的脆弱性＝植野大作氏 焦点：人民元国際化に低金利の追い風、起債や融資が拡大 コラム：人民元高が堅調な中国輸出の妨げとならない理由 最終更新: 10/16(金) 18:40 ロイター

"We're kind of going through an inflection point...a

Stablecoin issuer Circle to push into 40 new markets, CEO says

Jeremy Allaire, CEO and co-founder of Circle Internet Group, the issuer of one of the world's biggest stablecoins, attends an interview, on the day of his company's IPO at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), in New York City, U.S., June 5, 2025. REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

BANGKOK, Oct 16 : Stablecoin issuer Circle is making a major push to enter about 40 emerging and developing countries around the world as blockchain adoption is expected to scale up significantly, the company's CEO and chairman Jeremy Allaire told Reuters.  "We're kind of going through an inflection point...a transition right now, and that transition is essentially moving from the early adopter phase of blockchain technology into the mainstream scaling phase," said Allaire, who is also co-founder of the New York-listed company. He was speaking on the sidelines of the IMF and World Bank meetings in Bangkok. Markers in regions like Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East are seeing rising organic demand for stablecoins and digital utility from individual and businesses wanting to part of an internet-based economic system, Allaire said. Circle, the world’s largest regulated stablecoin issuer, is accelerating its global expansion, backed by a $400 million acquisition of Tazapay and a $100 million strategic investment from Binance.

It holds roughly 25 per cent of the global stablecoin market share, while rival USDT, which is issued by Tether, commands nearly 60 per cent. Stablecoins are cryptocurrencies designed to have a stable value relative to traditional cyrptos. Their increasing adoption is being driven by clearer regulatory frameworks, such as the U.S. Genius Act which is slated to take effect next January. Circle in July became one of the first stablecoin issuers to hold a federal bank charter.   "When the Genius Act goes into law, the world will have legal digital dollars...That is a watershed moment," Allaire said. Circle's U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin USDC saw a 19 per cent year-over-year rise in circulation to $73.3 billion in the second quarter this year. Banking coalitions in the U.S. and European markets are moving rapidly to develop and deploy their own stablecoins and digital asset solutions, which Allaire said was a sign of a healthy and competitive market. "There's a very, very long time where the banking industry fought successfully to keep other people out, and I think they are no longer in charge, and the innovators are having their day," he said. Major financial institutions and payment firms are moving past pilot programs to embed stablecoins for cross-border settlements and asset transfers. Circle offers on-chain infrastructure via its Arc operating system, which has been adopted by firms including BlackRock, Visa and Standard Chartered.  A surge in machine-to-machine transactions among AI agents has also propelled USDC use, Allaire said. They execute fractions-of-a-cent payments when doing web research or scraping real-time data. The executive also warned that the rapid expansion of AI brings heightened security vulnerabilities, noting that financial infrastructure providers face escalating threats from sophisticated actors and automated agent swarms.  "If you're not concerned about it, then your head is in the sand, right?” he said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Israeli settlers burn olive trees, injure journalist in West Bank attack
item.description: Clad in black and their faces masked, dozens of militant Israeli settlers burned olive trees and threw rocks at Palestinians in a coordinated attack on Friday on a West Bank village's annual harvest that injured at least two people including a journalist.
item.dc:creator: Pesha Magid, Ali Sawafta
item.content:encoded: Clad in black and their faces masked, dozens of militant Israeli settlers burned olive trees and threw rocks at Palestinians in a coordinated attack on Friday on a West Bank village's annual harvest that injured at least two people including a journalist. Some 80 settlers, some of them carrying gas canisters, descended from a hill above a terraced olive grove where villagers from Abu Falah had gathered to pick ripe fruit, a cherished annual tradition in Palestinian life, Reuters witnesses said. The settlers took positions in front of the terraced lanes of olive trees. Some of them used slings to launch rocks towards Palestinian villagers, who descended towards the bottom of the hill before picking up and throwing stones to defend themselves. "The settlers want to attack us and force us from our homes," said Moutaz Abdelhadi, 42, a farmer who witnessed the attack in Abu Falah. Partway through the attack, at least two Israeli military jeeps sped through the area, kicking up dust as villagers ran out of their way. The attack continued after the military's arrival, with Israeli soldiers firing tear gas in the direction of the Palestinians who had dodged the jeeps. The sound of live gunfire could be heard in the area, and a Reuters photographer saw at least one armed settler fire a gun. The Israeli military did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Palestinian medics said two people were injured and taken to hospitals in the area of Ramallah. One of them was Heidi Levine, a photojournalist with the Washington Post. Video of the attack showed Levine lying on her side on a dirt path with her hands over her face as at least three settlers surrounded her. Speaking from a hospital bed later, Levine, who is in stable condition, said: "I was attacked, pushed to the ground. Luckily I had my flak jacket and helmet, otherwise I probably wouldn't even be here, because they just kept kicking me and kicking me." Levine said the attack ended when her Palestinian colleagues intervened, after which medics rushed her in an ambulance to a clinic in Abu Falah and then to hospital in Ramallah. Her voice shook as she spoke and she had bandages over her left hand. The Washington Post did not immediately respond to a request for comment. SETTLER VIOLENCE HAS SURGED IN WEST BANK Israeli settler violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank has surged, with at least 170 attacks since September 27, around the start of the annual olive harvest, according to Yesh Din, an Israeli settlements monitoring group. The settlers have been emboldened by the right-wing government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who has overseen a rapid expansion of settlements and smaller outposts across the West Bank. Netanyahu has criticized the violence but has taken few steps to crack down on incidents that have drawn international condemnation and sanction plans by longtime Israeli allies, including Britain. The West Bank is home to some 500,000 settlers and at least 3 million Palestinians. UN bodies and most countries deem the settlements illegal under international law regarding military occupations. Israel rejects this, viewing the territory as disputed rather than occupied. The Abu Falah attack followed a similar attack on Friday morning in the area of Turmus Ayya village, where settlers burned three cars after attacking a group of farmers harvesting olives. The military did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Salah Abu Niswa, who witnessed the attack in Turmus Ayya, said the settlers "snuck up like thieves, they caught someone by himself and began to beat him."

item.title: ニデック株を買い増し、保有比率は9％超に＝オアシスＣＩＯ
item.description:
Miho Uranaka
[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 香港のアクティビスト（物言う株主）ファンド、オアシス・マネジ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ニデック株を買い増し、保有比率は9％超に＝オアシスＣＩＯ 18:23 配信

都内のニデック事業所で９月撮影。

Miho Uranaka

[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 香港のアクティビスト（物言う株主）ファンド、オアシス・マネジメントのセス・フィッシャー最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は１６日、都内で開催したチャリティイベントで、９％の株式保有を公表しているニデックについて、足元では保有比率がさらに高まっていることを明らかにした。その上で、条件次第では、保有比率を大幅に引き上げる可能性があるとの考えを示した。

フィッシャー氏は、「（昨日提出した）大量保有報告書では、同社株の保有比率は９％だが、現在はそれをやや上回っている。 大量保有報告書でも説明しているとおり、株価やその他の要因次第では保有比率を大幅に引き上げる可能性がある」と述べた。オアシスは１５日提出の報告書で、ニデック株について、５％超取得行為を予定していると明記していた。

数週間前に開かれたニデックの記者会見について「何をすべきかや、どのような措置を講じたのかについて十分な説明がなかった」と指摘。問題に直接関与した人物の処分や組織改革が遅れていることについて、「非常にがっかりしている」と語った。

同氏は、ニデックには取締役会レベルでの監督機能強化が必要との認識を示し、オアシスが取締役候補を提案しているという。会社側が迅速に対応しなければ、臨時株主総会（ＥＧＭ）の開催を求める可能性があると警告した。

さらに、ニデックは内部統制やコンプライアンス体制の整備を進める一方で、非公開化を含む戦略的な選択肢についても並行して検討すべきだと主張。「望まない形での上場廃止に追い込まれるリスクがある。それは株主や従業員にとって受け入れられない」と話した。

item.title: ＡＩ、安全策なければリスクが恩恵上回る恐れ＝ＩＭＦ専務理事
item.description:
Andrea Shalal Maria Martinez
[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ、安全策なければリスクが恩恵上回る恐れ＝ＩＭＦ専務理事 18:21 配信

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のゲオルギエワ専務理事。バンコクで10月16日撮影。 REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

Andrea Shalal　Maria Martinez

[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のゲオルギエワ専務理事は１６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）に適切な安全策や倫理的な枠組みを設けなければ、リスクが恩恵を上回る恐れがあると述べた。業界の自主規制に主要国政府の関与を組み合わせる考えを支持した。

米ＡＩ開発企業アンソロピック共同創業者のジャック・クラーク氏も参加したパネル討論で発言した。ＡＩは既に世界経済を押し上げているが、生産性の大幅な向上が期待されたほど早く実現しなければ、経済にマイナスのショックを及ぼす恐れもあると述べた。

「安全策がなければ、リスクが恩恵を上回るかもしれない。何よりも倫理的な基盤が必要だが、社会としてそこまで達しているかどうか、確信が持てない」と語った。

急速に進化するＡＩの恩恵を世界中の人々が受けるには、デジタルインフラや電力を利用できる環境、適切な規制といった一定の条件を整える必要があるとした。

また、これほど速く進化する技術にどう安全策を設けるかが、今やより大きな課題だと指摘。ＡＩの開発状況を、観客を守る防護柵がない中を猛スピードで走るＦ１マシンに例えた。

＜常識に即した基準＞

ゲオルギエワ氏は、絶えず変化するこの分野を規制・監督するのに政府は向いていないため、業界の自主規制が適切だと述べた。ただ社会との対話も必要だとした。米国、中国、インドなどＡＩ産業の規模が大きい国々に加え、ＡＩのサプライチェーン（供給網）に関わる国々も関与すべきだと語った。

ＩＭＦのような機関も、生産性の伸び、労働市場、金融安定へのリスクなど、それぞれの専門分野で関与すべきだと述べた。

クラーク氏は基準づくりは可能であり、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の初期段階の政策枠組みや米国での自主的な取り組みを通じ、既に始まりつつあると主張した。

同氏はアンソロピックが自社システムを定期的に試験し、試験の詳細を公表して情報を共有していると説明した。ただ、こうした取り組みを完全に自主性に委ねるべきではないとの考えを示した。

ＡＩを開発する国々による規制に賛成するかと問われると、「賛成だ。常識に即した基準が必要だ。それが最終的に技術への信頼を生み、経済を発展させる」と答えた。

また、アンソロピックは第三者の評価者を受け入れ、データを調べる権限を与えていると説明した。「最終的には、他の多くの企業もそうする必要があると考えている」と述べ、イーロン・マスク氏が自身の会社スペースＸも同様の取り組みを行う可能性に言及したことを歓迎した。

ブラウン米財務次官（国際担当）は別の記者会見で、ＩＭＦは世界経済のリスクに目を向け過ぎており、ＡＩのように経済にプラスのショックをもたらす可能性をもっと重視すべきだと述べた。

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のベイリー総裁は国際金融協会（ＩＩＦ）の会合で、ＡＩの試験基準を巡って各国の足並みがそろうことについて、１カ月前より楽観的になったと述べた。

別のパネル討論で、ドイツ連邦銀行（中銀）のナーゲル総裁が、ＡＩは世界の不均衡を拡大させる可能性があると述べた。「ハードウエアとソフトウエア開発の両面でＡＩに巨額の投資が必要なことを考えれば、それは明らかだ」と語った。

ハーバード大学の経済学者ダニ・ロドリック氏は、ＡＩによる生産性向上が実現するかどうかは分からず、もろ刃の剣になっていると指摘した。先週、ベルリンで開かれた学際的な会議の後、ロイターに語った。

生産性が向上すれば、影響を受ける業種で大規模な雇用喪失が起き、職を追われる人が出る可能性がある。一方、向上しなければ、データセンターへの巨額投資が多大な損失を伴う金融面の調整を引き起こしかねないと述べた。「雇用危機か金融危機か、どちらに対処することになるのか分からない」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ株売りに勢い、資金調達に懸念　クライマックスには距離 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か 最終更新: 10/16(金) 18:50 ロイター

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝反発、ＡＩ企業の自社株買い好感 当局の支援観測
item.description: [１６日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は反発。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業が相次いで自社株買いや好調な業績見通しを発表した...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝反発、ＡＩ企業の自社株買い好感　当局の支援観測 18:14 配信

3月、上海で撮影。 REUTERS/Go Nakamura

[１６日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は反発。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業が相次いで自社株買いや好調な業績見通しを発表したことが支えとなった。ただ、週間では３カ月ぶりの大幅な下げとなった。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．１％高で終了。上海総合指数は０．２％高。ただ、ＣＳＩ３００指数は週間では３．４％下落し、７月中旬以来の大幅な下げ。１０週連続の下落となった。

ハイテク株は下げ止まった。光トランシーバーメーカーの蘇州旭創科技（イオプトリンク）や半導体製造装置メーカーの北京屹唐半導体科技（パイオテック）など、少なくとも１０社のＡＩサプライチェーン関連企業が自社株買いや株式取得計画を発表した。

また半導体メーカーの沐曦集成電路（メタエックス）などハイテク企業が相次いで、高成長を示す第３・四半期の業績予想を発表した。

取引終盤には、「国家隊」と呼ばれる政府系投資家が選好する複数の上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の商いが急増。政府が株式市場支援に動いたとの観測が広がった。

さらにブルームバーグ・ニュースは、規制当局が企業や政府系ファンドに株式購入を促し、一部の投資家に売却を控えるよう指導していると報じた。

不動産と防衛関連株も３％超上昇した。

香港市場ではバイオテクノロジー株と不動産株が急伸した。

item.title: UK competition regulator targets Microsoft's business software grip
item.description: Britain's competition watchdog proposed designating Microsoft with "strategic market status" in business software, potentially paving the way for interventions in how the US tech major bundles products such as Excel, Teams and its Copilot AI assistant.
item.dc:creator: Paul Sandle, Yadarisa Shabong
item.content:encoded: Britain's competition watchdog proposed designating Microsoft (MSFT.O) with "strategic market status" in business software, potentially paving the way for interventions in how the US tech major bundles products such as Excel, Teams and its Copilot AI assistant. The Competition and Markets Authority launched an investigation in May into whether Microsoft's position in software used by around 20 million people a month in Britain was uncompetitive. On Friday, the regulator said it had found that Microsoft had a strong position in personal computer operating systems and productivity, security, server and database management software, reinforced by barriers customers faced when switching. A Microsoft spokesperson said it did not share the CMA's view. "All our products — including Copilot — are open and interoperable, giving customers the ability to use them alongside competing services," the spokesperson said. AI COMPETITION The CMA said it would investigate whether customers could freely choose AI tools and whether rivals could compete with Copilot. It would also examine whether Microsoft's bundling of security products limited choice and how its licensing practices affected customers' cloud options. CMA Chief Executive Sarah Cardell said business software and cloud services underpinned workplaces across Britain, from small firms to vital public services. "Organisations should be able to choose the products that work best for them, switch provider when they want to and combine services from different suppliers," she said. "We want to ensure businesses have the freedom to choose how they use Microsoft's products alongside alternatives." The regulator will invite views on the proposed designation and will then make a final decision by February. If designated, Microsoft would become the third company subject to Britain's new digital market powers. Alphabet-owned Google (GOOGL.O) was designated in online search, while Google and Apple (AAPL.O) were designated in mobile platforms in October 2025. In June, the CMA [USN:L8N42P0FJ TEXT:"imposed"] new conduct requirements on Google's search services, including allowing publishers to stop their content being used to power the US company's AI features and requiring greater transparency over how its search rankings work. The CMA also said on Friday that Amazon Web Services (AMZN.O) and Microsoft needed to address remaining barriers to switching between cloud providers and using multiple cloud services. Both companies had taken steps to support greater choice, including connecting their data centres with rivals, starting with Google, and removing data transfer fees for customers switching providers. But the CMA said more could be done. The regulator said it would continue working with the companies while keeping the possibility of launching a formal investigation into the cloud sector under review. "We welcome the CMA's acknowledgement that Microsoft's market position in cloud does not justify a Digital Markets Competition Regime designation," a Microsoft spokesperson said. AWS said it also welcomed the update. "We've continued to invest throughout 2026 in new AI, multicloud, and open-standard capabilities that give customers more control over how they build and operate," AWS said.

item.title: 中国、ＡＩなど40技術で輸出規制案 対象外設定で企業に海外展開余地
item.description:
Eduardo Baptista
［北京 １６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Eduardo Baptista

［北京　１６日　ロイター］ - 中国商務省は１６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）モデル、ＡＩエージェント、計算クラスターに関わる技術など、ＡＩ分野の２３技術を対象とする輸出規制案を発表した。最先端技術の開発を巡り米国との競争が激しくなるなか、不可欠と見なす技術の移転を制限する最新の動きとなる。

改定案は、ＡＩのほかバイオ医薬、太陽光発電の分野など４０の技術を対象としている。１１月１５日まで一般から意見を募る。同時に、対象となる技術には暫定措置として輸出前の登録制度を導入する。

商務省は今回の改定について、機微な分野で関連技術の応用が広がり続けていることを理由に挙げた。また特定の国や地域、組織を狙い撃ちした措置ではないと説明した。

改定案では、制限対象技術を含むＡＩモデルの海外展開を対象とする一方、アプリケーション・プログラミング・インターフェース（ＡＰＩ）、ウェブサイト、アプリ、サービスとしてのソフトウエア（ＳａａＳ）プラットフォーム経由でのアクセスは対象外とする。

この区分けにより、ディープシークやアリババといった中国のＡＩ開発企業による海外展開の余地が残される一方、中国政府は機微なＡＩ技術の海外移転に対する監督を強められる見通し。

ディープシークの「Ｒ１」モデルが２０２５年に登場して以降、中国製ＡＩモデルは低価格と性能改善を背景に海外で存在感を高めている。ＡＩ分野の管理をどこまで厳格化するかを決める上で、中国政府にとって重みを増している。

ロイターは７月、中国当局がアリババ、バイトダンスなど主要テクノロジー企業と、未公開のものを含む中国の最先端人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルへの海外からのアクセスを制限する可能性について協議したと報じていた。

商務省は１６日、悪意あるソフトウエアを自律的に生成・改変できるシステムなどＡＩ技術の悪用防止も規制の目的と説明。大半のＡＩ技術は引き続き自由に輸出できるとし、オープンソース技術の輸出や中国企業が自社で運営する海外のコンピューティングセンターは簡素化した許可手続きを適用する。オープンソースでの公開や学術論文ですでに知られている技術は規制案の対象外になる。

改定案には、一部の新規細胞・遺伝子治療と低分子干渉ＲＮＡ（ｓｉＲＮＡ）技術に関する知的財産権の移転を禁じる内容も盛り込まれている。

item.title: Newly identified green star leaves astronomers amazed
item.description: WASHINGTON, Oct 16 : Astronomers for the first time have identified a green star, documenting a dense stellar remnant called a white dwarf that became a ghostly shade of chartreuse after ingesting rocky debris from planets that once had orbited it.A star's color typically is governed by its temperature, with
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Newly identified green star leaves astronomers amazed

An artist's impression of the cool white dwarf star WDJ1330+6435, which has accreted sodium-rich rocky material from its planetary system into its atmosphere, and the star's immense atmospheric density causes the sodium to absorb light over broad range of yellow, orange and red wavelengths, giving it a ghostly green appearance, in a handout image released on October 14, 2026. Mark A. Garlick/University of Warwick/Handout via REUTERS

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 16 : Astronomers for the first time have identified a green star, documenting a dense stellar remnant called a white dwarf that became a ghostly shade of chartreuse after ingesting rocky debris from planets that once had orbited it. A star's color typically is governed by its temperature, with cooler stars appearing orange, the sun and stars similar to it appearing white, and the hottest ones appearing a pale blue. But the formula is different for a white dwarf, which is the leftover core of a low- to medium-mass star that burned through its nuclear fuel and blew off its outer layers. Most white dwarfs have colors similar to other stars, and their average color is white. But changes in their chemistry over time can turn some of them into rarer colors. The newly identified green one, named WD J1330+6435, is a white dwarf in the Milky Way galaxy that is located about 280 light-years from Earth in the constellation Draco. A light-year is the distance light travels in a year, 5.9 trillion miles (9.5 trillion km).

"We first became interested in this white dwarf because bits of planetary material have fallen onto its surface, enriching its outer layers in elements including calcium, lithium and, in particular, sodium," said astrophysicist Mark Hollands of the University of Warwick in England, lead author of the study published in the journal RAS Techniques and Instruments. In normal stars, sodium absorbs a very specific wavelength of orange — the same orange that gives sodium street lamps their characteristic color. "In this particular white dwarf, however, the density is so high that the sodium atoms are constantly being bombarded by surrounding helium atoms, which alters the sodium atomic energy levels," Hollands said. "The end result is that the sodium atoms no longer absorb one very narrow wavelength of orange — they absorb the yellows, oranges and some of the red wavelengths. And what you're left with is a star that has a beautiful chartreuse green glow, something that wouldn't be possible for sun-like stars," Hollands said. The discovery was part of a project assessing the color of white dwarfs as human eyes would see them. A white dwarf typically has half the mass of the sun compacted into the size of Earth. "Because white dwarfs are super-dense stars — they are roughly the size of the Earth, but contain about 165,000 times its mass — even a small amount of sodium blocks out a large amount of the orange light coming out of the star," University of Warwick astrophysicist and study co-author Boris Gänsicke said. "In the end, it's all very similar to the mixing of colors in the palette of a painter. They start with a few basic colors, then mix them together to form any color they need for their painting. Take away some of the color going into the mix, and the output will change," Gänsicke said. A STAR THAT IS SALMON PINK The researchers studied 151 white dwarfs located within about 65 light-years of Earth, with white the average color. One showed perhaps the reddest hue of any known star, a salmon pink. Named WD J1011+2845, it is located 48 light-years from Earth in the constellation Leo Minor. This time, it was not sodium that was changing the palette, but carbon. "Rather than something hitting the star, in this case the carbon comes out from its deep interior," Gänsicke said. Data used by the researchers included light spectrum observations from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey using a telescope in New Mexico, as well as white dwarf spectrum models they developed. They found that white dwarf colors divide into distinct groups based on atmospheric composition. Carbon-rich white dwarfs usually were pink or purple. Those enriched with debris from shattered remnants of planetary systems leaned toward yellow. Lower-temperature white dwarfs with mixed hydrogen and helium atmospheres tended toward a cyan or pale blue hue. In all, they spanned almost every color of the spectrum. While WD J1330+6435 was the first documented example of a green star in the real world, green stars have existed in science fiction, including in the recent comic book movie "Supergirl." "It does show that the universe is sometimes just as weird as anything science fiction can conjure up," Hollands said.

Source: Reuters
